reason: Expert explains that nightly CPU spikes on aggregation routers are caused by the config backup job and are a known false alarm unless thresholds are exceeded.

knowledge.summary: On aggregation routers, a nightly CPU spike around 88% lasting about 14 minutes is caused by the config backup job and can be ignored unless it exceeds 95% for more than 10 minutes.
knowledge.author: Antti Aalto
knowledge.details: Nightly CPU spike at 88% for about 14 minutes. Ignore unless over 95% for more than 10 minutes.
